title: Mechanisms of Severe Acute Influenza Consortium (MOSAIC)
brief_summary: The ultimate goal of this collaborative, intensive study is to discover new and effective treatments and to develop better vaccines that can be used in future outbreaks of Influenza A. By integrating the information that we will gather, we will create a unique overview of how influenza causes illness and what might be done to improve patient management.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any patient admitted to hospital with suspected or confirmed influenza infection

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who do not give their consent
